# Files CI downloads from GitHub releases, pinned by sha256 and kept in the GitHub Actions cache (.github/actions/pinned-downloads),
# so a GitHub releases outage does not fail a run once a file has been fetched. One per line: name, sha256, URL.
# A pin changes here, and the cache key changes with it.
#
# The openZIM testing suite (packages/cache_search/native/zimx/fetch-test-zim.sh holds the same pin and checks it again).
